name: Prophet Arena
description: Prophet Arena evaluates LLMs as forecasters using economic utility (profit from prediction market bets) rather than Brier scores as the primary performance metric. The benchmark finds that LLMs show impressive probabilistic calibration but suffer significantly from inaccurate event recall, limiting real-world forecasting profit.
reputation: Cited in the context of LLM forecasting evaluation; advocates for profit-based utility metrics over calibration scores as a more practically relevant measure.
notes: Key finding: LLMs are well-calibrated in probability assignment but poor at event recall, which undermines actual betting profitability. Argues Brier score alone is insufficient as a forecasting benchmark metric.
